mapper.insert: INSERT INTO join_task ( name, account_group_ids, account_group_names, selected_account_ids, links_text, distribution_mode, accounts_per_link, executor_account_count, links_per_account, fixed_interval_min_sec, fixed_interval_max_sec, multi_interval_min_sec, multi_interval_max_sec, interval_label, retry_enabled, retry_limit, failure_policy, is_set_admin_enabled, is_clear_admins_and_leave_enabled, total, executed, success, failed, pending, status, owner_user_id, created_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{accountGroupIds}, #{accountGroupNames}, #{selectedAccountIds}, #{linksText}, #{distributionMode}, #{accountsPerLink}, #{executorAccountCount}, #{linksPerAccount}, #{fixedIntervalMinSec}, #{fixedIntervalMaxSec}, #{multiIntervalMinSec}, #{multiIntervalMaxSec}, #{intervalLabel}, #{retryEnabled}, #{retryLimit}, #{failurePolicy}, #{setAdminEnabled}, #{clearAdminsAndLeaveEnabled}, #{total}, #{executed}, #{success}, #{failed}, #{pending}, #{status}, #{ownerUserId}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM join_task WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM join_task WHERE ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT DISTINCT interval_label FROM join_task WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND interval_label <> '' ORDER BY interval_label
mapper.update: UPDATE join_task SET name=#{name}, account_group_ids=#{accountGroupIds}, account_group_names=#{accountGroupNames}, selected_account_ids=#{selectedAccountIds}, links_text=#{linksText}, distribution_mode=#{distributionMode}, accounts_per_link=#{accountsPerLink}, executor_account_count=#{executorAccountCount}, links_per_account=#{linksPerAccount}, fixed_interval_min_sec=#{fixedIntervalMinSec}, fixed_interval_max_sec=#{fixedIntervalMaxSec}, multi_interval_min_sec=#{multiIntervalMinSec}, multi_interval_max_sec=#{multiIntervalMaxSec}, interval_label=#{intervalLabel}, retry_enabled=#{retryEnabled}, retry_limit=#{retryLimit}, failure_policy=#{failurePolicy}, is_set_admin_enabled=#{setAdminEnabled}, is_clear_admins_and_leave_enabled=#{clearAdminsAndLeaveEnabled}, owner_user_id=#{ownerUserId}, total=#{total}, pending=#{pending}, updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE join_task SET status=#{status}, updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE join_task SET executed = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM join_task_result r LEFT JOIN join_task_cleanup c ON c.result_id=r.id AND c.tenant_id=r.tenant_id WHERE r.join_task_id=#{taskId} AND r.account_id IS NOT NULL AND (r.status='FAILED' OR (r.status='SUCCESS' AND r.admin_status=4) OR (r.status='SUCCESS' AND r.admin_status IN (0,3) AND COALESCE(c.status,0) IN (0,7,8))) ), success = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM join_task_result r LEFT JOIN join_task_cleanup c ON c.result_id=r.id AND c.tenant_id=r.tenant_id WHERE r.join_task_id=#{taskId} AND r.account_id IS NOT NULL AND r.status='SUCCESS' AND r.admin_status IN (0,3) AND COALESCE(c.status,0) IN (0,7) ), failed = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM join_task_result r LEFT JOIN join_task_cleanup c ON c.result_id=r.id AND c.tenant_id=r.tenant_id WHERE r.join_task_id=#{taskId} AND r.account_id IS NOT NULL AND (r.status='FAILED' OR (r.status='SUCCESS' AND (r.admin_status=4 OR c.status=8))) ), pending = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM join_task_result r LEFT JOIN join_task_cleanup c ON c.result_id=r.id AND c.tenant_id=r.tenant_id WHERE r.join_task_id=#{taskId} AND r.account_id IS NOT NULL AND (r.status='PENDING' OR (r.status='SUCCESS' AND (r.admin_status IN (1,2,5) OR c.status IN (1,2,3,4,5,6)))) ) WHERE id=#{taskId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE join_task SET status = 'RUNNING', updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'DRAFT'

UPDATE join_task t SET t.status = 'DONE', t.updated_at = #{now} WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.status = 'RUNNING' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM join_task_result r LEFT JOIN join_task_cleanup c ON c.result_id=r.id AND c.tenant_id=r.tenant_id WHERE r.join_task_id = t.id AND (r.status = 'PENDING' OR (r.status = 'SUCCESS' AND (r.admin_status IN (1, 2, 5) OR c.status IN (1,2,3,4,5,6)))) )
